Super Eurobeat, Vol. 250 marked 28 years of music for the Italian genre that in the 2000s overtook artists like Madonna in Japanese charts, but while the numbered series might be over, the party is not and Super Eurobeat 2025 is to be released on Nov. 5th.

Never heard of it? Start your journey from Wikipedia!
